dct_description_sm: This project evaluated the effect of BlackHawk (NUP12130) as compared with industry standards, QuickSilver (carfentrazone-ethyl) and other commercially available surfactants and herbicides. Turfgrass growth and quality parameters on a mature bentgrass/annual bluegrass greens height stand of turf were evaluated, as well as efficacy of the products on moss control.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Efficacy of herbicide products for moss control on a ‘California’ sand putting green
